title: Modern Web Design System & UX Best Practices
keyTechniques: Use HSL or CSS variable color palettes with curated primary, accent, surface, and semantic colors
Establish clear typography scale using modern web fonts (e.g., Inter, Outfit, Roboto) with defined font-weights and line-heights
Implement fluid responsive layouts using CSS Grid for 2D page regions and Flexbox for 1D component alignement
Add subtle micro-animations (transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out) on interactive elements (buttons, cards, links) to enhance tactile feel
Maintain consistent spacing using an 8px grid system (margin/padding in multiples of 4px or 8px)
avoid: Do not use browser default fonts or un-styled HTML buttons
Do not use harsh 100% black (#000000) or plain un-curated primary colors like pure #ff0000 / #0000ff
Do not use fixed pixel widths on container elements that break mobile responsiveness
